title: Near-Infrared Lanthanide-Based Emission from Fused Bis[Ln(III)/Zn(II) 14-metallacrown-5] Coordination Compounds

synthesis.procedure: The main text states only that Ln-1 was obtained by stoichiometric self-assembly in N,N-dimethylformamide followed by water diffusion into the DMF solution. The SI general procedure was used for Tb-1: terbium(III) triflate (1 equiv, 0.100 mmol, 0.0606 g) and zinc(II) triflate (3 equiv, 0.3000 mmol, 0.1091 g) were dissolved in DMF (2.5 mL). Separately, quinaldic hydroxamic acid (2.5 equiv, 0.250 mmol, 0.0471 g), phthalic acid (1.5 equiv, 0.150 mmol, 0.0260 g), and triethylamine (16 equiv, 1.60 mmol, 0.223 mL) were dissolved in DMF (7.5 mL). The solutions were combined, stirred for 1 h, gravity filtered, and the filtrate was set in a diffusion chamber with purified water. After 2–4 weeks, yellow block crystals were collected by vacuum filtration. The SI bulk formula is written with (OH)4, whereas the main-text structural formula writes (OH)8.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Erlenmeyer flask, then gravity filtration and water-diffusion chamber
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Gravity filtration followed by diffusion of purified water into the DMF filtrate; yellow block crystals collected by vacuum filtration.

properties.summary: Solid-state diffuse reflectance of Tb-1 shows broad UV–visible bands extending to 550 nm. Excitation into the intraligand charge-transfer band gives only broad emission at 450–750 nm; characteristic Tb3+ f–f emission is not observed and is attributed to back energy transfer between the ILCT state (21410 cm−1) and the Tb3+ 5D4 level (20500 cm−1).

properties.summary: Gd-1 was used to locate ligand-centered levels. No phosphorescence was detected at 77 K under 280–340 nm excitation in time-resolved mode. Steady-state emission is a broad intraligand charge-transfer band at 450–750 nm, with the ILCT onset at 21410 cm−1 (467 nm). Diffuse reflectance shows broad bands to 550 nm. No magnetic data are reported for Gd-1.

synthesis.procedure: The main text reports stoichiometric self-assembly in N,N-dimethylformamide and crystallization by diffusion of water into the DMF solution; single-crystal analysis was performed on Yb-1. In the SI, ytterbium(III) triflate (1 equiv, 0.100 mmol, 0.0620 g) and zinc(II) triflate (3 equiv, 0.3000 mmol, 0.1091 g) were dissolved in DMF (2.5 mL). Quinaldic hydroxamic acid (2.5 equiv, 0.250 mmol, 0.0471 g), phthalic acid (1.5 equiv, 0.150 mmol, 0.0260 g), and triethylamine (16 equiv, 1.60 mmol, 0.223 mL) were dissolved in DMF (7.5 mL). The solutions were combined, stirred for 1 h, gravity filtered, and crystallized by diffusion of purified water. Yellow blocks formed after 2–4 weeks and were collected by vacuum filtration. Crystallography states that the yellow blocks were grown from DMF/water at 22 °C. The crystal formula in Table S1 is C173.50H163.50Zn12N28.50O70.50Yb4 [+SOLVENT] (CCDC 2125941); the SI bulk/EA formula uses (OH)4, while the main text describes eight hydroxide ligands.
synthesis.temperature: 22 °C for crystal growth; reaction temperature not stated
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Erlenmeyer flask, then gravity filtration and water-diffusion chamber
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Gravity filtration and diffusion of purified water into DMF; yellow block crystals collected by vacuum filtration. A crystal (0.184 × 0.253 × 0.665 mm) was measured at 100(2) K.

properties.summary: Yb-1 shows solid-state Yb3+-centered NIR emission from the 2F5/2 → 2F7/2 transition upon excitation at 400 nm, sensitized by the metallacrown scaffold despite coordinated water. The absolute quantum yield is 0.051(1)% and the monoexponential observed lifetime is 714(8) ns, both smaller than a related Zn/Yb encapsulated-sandwich metallacrown. No magnetic measurements of Yb-1 are reported.
